item.title: How the world's largest truck stop makes 350,000 meals a year
item.description: Iowa 80 in Walcott, Iowa, is the Disney World for truckers. But why are family-owned truck stops like this one drying up across America?

item.title: Critical Role's cofounders say they faced 3 big challenges making their new Prime Video series
item.description: "Mighty Nein" is the Critical Role crew's second animated series project with Amazon.

item.title: My manager and I got laid off, so we packed up our wetsuits and went to surf camp in Bali
item.description: Heath Kitson and William Lu planned a trip to Bali to learn surfing after getting laid off from their bank jobs.

item.title: Elon Musk says Tesla is now testing driverless robotaxis, without a human safety monitor, on Austin's streets
item.description: A video circulating online appeared to show a Tesla Model Y robotaxi with no safety monitor inside driving on Austin streets.

item.title: I'm an empty nester and spent 6 months on my own in 3 countries. It helped me figure out what I wanted next.
item.description: Jennifer McGuire was afraid of waiting around for her four adult sons to visit, so she booked a solo trip to Italy, France, and Northern Ireland.

item.title: Reddit is arguing it's a 'collection of public fora' and not a social media company. Here's why.
item.description: In a lawsuit challenging an Australian law barring children under 16 from having social media accounts, Reddit argues it's not a social media company.

item.title: Robot vacuum Roomba's parent company is filing for bankruptcy after cash struggles and a failed acquisition by Amazon
item.description: The bankruptcy announcement comes after cash struggles and a failed acquisition by Amazon.

item.title: Michelle Obama says she never understood something her mom always said — until she had kids of her own
item.description: "I think she wanted me to know throughout my life, she wanted to hand us our lives early. Like you're responsible," Michelle Obama said.

item.title: AI is triggering a quiet hiring comeback for some entry-level talent, say public company CEOs
item.description: A new survey shows CEOs expect AI to boost hiring in 2026, especially for entry-level roles.

item.title: Rob Reiner, director of 'The Princess Bride,' is dead at 78
item.description: Reiner and his wife, Michelle Singer Reiner, were found dead in their home in Brentwood, Los Angeles, on Sunday.
